steps.description: Join s to its own reverse with a separator so a match can never cross from one half into the other: "aacecaaa#aaacecaa".
lps[0] = 0 always - a single character has no shorter prefix to match against itself.
combined[1]='a' matches combined[0]='a' - extend the match to length 1 and record lps[1]=1.
combined[2]='c' breaks the match of length 1 - fall back to the next-best recorded match length 0 (lps[0]) without moving i forward.
combined[2]='c' does not match combined[0]='a', and there is no shorter match left to fall back to - lps[2] = 0.
combined[3]='e' does not match combined[0]='a', and there is no shorter match left to fall back to - lps[3] = 0.
combined[4]='c' does not match combined[0]='a', and there is no shorter match left to fall back to - lps[4] = 0.
combined[5]='a' matches combined[0]='a' - extend the match to length 1 and record lps[5]=1.
combined[6]='a' matches combined[1]='a' - extend the match to length 2 and record lps[6]=2.
combined[7]='a' breaks the match of length 2 - fall back to the next-best recorded match length 1 (lps[1]) without moving i forward.
combined[7]='a' matches combined[1]='a' - extend the match to length 2 and record lps[7]=2.
combined[8]='#' breaks the match of length 2 - fall back to the next-best recorded match length 1 (lps[1]) without moving i forward.
combined[8]='#' breaks the match of length 1 - fall back to the next-best recorded match length 0 (lps[0]) without moving i forward.
combined[8]='#' does not match combined[0]='a', and there is no shorter match left to fall back to - lps[8] = 0.
combined[9]='a' matches combined[0]='a' - extend the match to length 1 and record lps[9]=1.
combined[10]='a' matches combined[1]='a' - extend the match to length 2 and record lps[10]=2.
combined[11]='a' breaks the match of length 2 - fall back to the next-best recorded match length 1 (lps[1]) without moving i forward.
combined[11]='a' matches combined[1]='a' - extend the match to length 2 and record lps[11]=2.
combined[12]='c' matches combined[2]='c' - extend the match to length 3 and record lps[12]=3.
combined[13]='e' matches combined[3]='e' - extend the match to length 4 and record lps[13]=4.
combined[14]='c' matches combined[4]='c' - extend the match to length 5 and record lps[14]=5.
combined[15]='a' matches combined[5]='a' - extend the match to length 6 and record lps[15]=6.
combined[16]='a' matches combined[6]='a' - extend the match to length 7 and record lps[16]=7.
lps[16]=7 - the first 7 characters of s are already a palindrome anchored at the start. Mirror everything after that onto the front: "aaacecaaa".
